Subject: Kelridge Grill Holdings - Referral Required

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the submission on Kelridge Grill Holdings. I've reviewed the information and have everything I need from a documentation standpoint.

However, this risk requires referral to our senior underwriting team due to coastal exposure concerns. We have one location within 16 km of the coast, and our existing portfolio concentration in that area is already quite high.

Given these accumulation challenges, this may fall outside our current appetite. I'd recommend reaching out to a specialty coastal property market that can better accommodate this exposure—they'll likely provide more competitive terms as well.

I appreciate you thinking of us, and please don't hesitate to reach out with other opportunities that might be a better fit.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
